title: CosmoMail
brief: You are a recruiter at Northwind. Reply to Jordan, who passed the technical screen and is asking about next steps. Lay out the process and propose scheduling the final panel. Jordan will respond — read carefully and keep the thread moving to a booked slot.

initialDraft.subject: Re: Next steps — Senior Engineer interview

assistant.systemPromptExtra: Coach the learner toward clear, candidate-friendly scheduling communication with concrete options and next steps.
assistant.initialMessage: Want help laying out the next steps and proposing times?

scriptedBeats: Thanks for the details! Tuesday afternoon works best for me — say 2:00pm ET. Could you send a calendar invite and let me know who I'll be meeting?
Perfect, 2:00pm ET Tuesday is booked on my end. Looking forward to it — thank you!

rubricHints.notes: Reward: warm confirmation of passing the screen, a clear outline of remaining steps, concrete scheduling options, and a prompt, professional follow-through that lands a booked time. The recipient replies are scripted (fixed beats) regardless of wording.
